values.graph: complete_view -> roster -> close -> freeze -> scan -> drain -> restore -> resume
values.ownershipDecision: User selected VM-local mutable primitive overrides with shared immutable code templates. Existing Scheme names remain. Each owning globals shard scans and rewrites its override slot; presence bits and code templates are nonroots. A module rebind clears only the loading VM override. Other VM overrides survive. VM setup constructs the storage before publication and cleanup frees it after leases drain. Native relocation, cross-VM isolation, rebind and repeated lifecycle cases must pass; the historical observed3/required7 remains a negative witness.
values.cost: Coordinator setup owns sizeof(root_round) native bytes, including bounded MAX_PROCESSORS descriptors; each RC domain gains two pointers. Root-bank storage is NARGS+1 native pointers plus one existing RC allocation per raw Scheme input; each generated entry installs a catcher. Ordinary stores gain a noncollecting owner/phase/union check and call, not a per-store mutex. Four extra unconditional GC collective calls versus the selected predecessor. Multiple-VM storage adds CAP Scheme words plus ceil(CAP/WORD_WIDTH) bitmap words per VM; CAP is the existing20000 global capacity, not a new limit. Single-VM uses two fields per registered global. Primitive lookup adds presence and slot loads; primitive publication adds the existing global mutex, not a GC wait. Measure actual sizes and costs; no speedup, RSS or throughput claim.
values.formalDuty: Reuse root_store_projection and root_enumeration Quint histories for close/store/borrow and source coverage; runtime_roles owns collective scan/strong/weak/prepare/resume order. Reuse RuntimeOwnership canonicalAliasesShareUpdatedCell, rewriteCoversEveryDeclaredRoot and reloadRestoresValueAgreement only after actual C slot/lifetime premises. Source refinement owns current-processor exclusivity, collective happens-before, epoch arithmetic, native argument reload, compiler/header binding and catcher cleanup. Native tests own execution/replay/shrink. Do not duplicate either formal model or treat LLM review as native proof.
values.union.obligation: VM and symkey plus each member RC/globals/stack/bank retain their actual source identities and original scan order.
values.epoch.obligation: Every admitted RC source receives the VM union epoch, including newly initialized members; local counters are not the roster authority.
values.cut.obligation: Complete saved frame/context views and first collective precede capture; roster lifetime and current-processor uniqueness must be traced to actual callers.
values.writers.obligation: Only the current exclusive processor writes, with no poll/allocation/callback before final store. Collective ordering supplies scan visibility; the RC name or a count snapshot alone proves nothing.
values.shared.obligation: GLOBALVARPRIMSET and PRM retain Scheme names but read/write owning VM override storage. DEF_MOD_PRM alone publishes permanent code through bind_primitive and clears the loading VM override. A shared image field must never hold an owning heap pointer; raw PRMCELL is an rvalue. Canonical override slots are scanned once by their owning global shard. Trace _gsclib, reflection, module setup and raw consumers.
values.cell.obligation: Generated SET_GLO, reflective GLOBALVARSET and DEF_MOD_GLO use store_global on the owning canonical value cell. No alias snapshot becomes an independent scan task.
values.reload.obligation: After marker/conversion GC reload raw Scheme parameters from their RC slots when writing actual Scheme arguments. Keep those slots through logical continuation transfer until physical host exit.
values.moduleEntry.obligation: Generated module setup receives the loading processor explicitly. Old modules must fail runtime size/version admission before an old function table or setup signature is invoked.
values.storage.obligation: VM slot allocation is checked and all values/bits initialize before usable VM publication. setup.c propagates failure and rolls back linked VM/OS state. Leases and borrowers drain before freeing the single block; repeated setup/cleanup must not reuse stale override state.
values.image.obligation: Raw PRMCELL consumers in setup and _kernel.scm address fixed image labels and must read immutable template code, not a user override with an arbitrary frame shape. setup.c also temporarily reads the prepublication symbol hash from prm. Ordinary Scheme PRM and reflective reads use VM overrides. External private raw writes must fail source admission. CPU fixup operations3/4 previously returned unbounded writable global/primitive addresses; now propagate UNIMPL before code can run. This C-target REV does not claim a redesigned CPU backend root-borrow protocol.
values.borrows.obligation: A borrow pins the canonical RC slot, prevents payload rebinding/retirement and remains scanned. Actual startup/on_all_processors and marker callers reload after allocating calls and return the loan at their physical boundary. The current processor is the only executing Scheme owner; a suspended enclosing C frame is not a concurrent cell reader. Borrowing does not admit an arbitrary asynchronous C reader or a foreign-VM Scheme object.
values.entryRoots.obligation: Every raw Scheme parameter is registered before the first collecting marker/conversion and reloaded at actual argument transfer.
values.entryExit.obligation: Volatile entry records and marker survive catcher recovery; normal and continuation-unwind paths release roots before propagating control.
values.control.obligation: Scheme continuation restoration may execute inside a still-live inner C trampoline. Keep entry roots across that interval and its GC. Only an actual return to the enclosing host marker establishes physical unwind and final drain; Scheme logical escape alone is not that receipt.
values.retirement.obligation: Local task DONE cannot authorize domain cleanup; the restored collective alone drops joined-round custody.
